license_required.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of podiatric medicine and surgery without a current, valid license to practice podiatric medicine and surgery issued by the state medical board.

issuing_authority.quote: a person seeking a license to practice podiatric medicine and surgery shall file with the state medical board an application

age_minimum.quote: Is at least eighteen years of age

degree_required.value: Degree from a college of podiatric medicine and surgery
degree_required.quote: Holds a degree from a college of podiatric medicine and surgery that was in good standing with the board at the time the degree was granted

accrediting_body.quote: a college of podiatric medicine and surgery that was in good standing with the board at the time the degree was granted, as determined by the board

required.quote: Has completed one year of postgraduate training in a podiatric internship, residency, or clinical fellowship program accredited by the council on podiatric medicine or the American podiatric medical association or its equivalent as determined by the board

duration.quote: Has completed one year of postgraduate training in a podiatric internship, residency, or clinical fellowship program

kind.value: podiatric internship, residency, or clinical fellowship program
kind.quote: one year of postgraduate training in a podiatric internship, residency, or clinical fellowship program accredited by the council on podiatric medicine or the American podiatric medical association

exams.name: Podiatric medicine and surgery competency examination
exams.notes: Examination prescribed in rules adopted by the board
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an examination prescribed in rules adopted by the board to determine competency to practice podiatric medicine and surgery

interval_years.quote: A license issued under this chapter to practice medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or podiatric medicine and surgery shall be valid for a two-year period unless revoked or suspended.

required.quote: each person holding a license to practice medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or podiatric medicine and surgery issued by the state medical board shall complete biennially not less than fifty hours of continuing medical education that has been approved by the board.

hours_per_period.quote: shall complete biennially not less than fifty hours of continuing medical education

period_years.quote: shall complete biennially not less than fifty hours of continuing medical education

value: Continuing medical education certified by the Ohio podiatric medical association
topical_requirements.quote: Continuing medical education completed by holders of licenses to practice podiatric medicine and surgery that is certified by the Ohio podiatric medical association.

available.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice podiatric medicine and surgery in accordance with Chapter 4796. of the Revised Code to an applicant if either of the following applies: (1) The applicant holds a license in another state.

requirements.value: Applicant holds a license in another state, or has satisfactory work experience, government certification, or private certification as a podiatrist in a state that does not issue that license.
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice podiatric medicine and surgery in accordance with Chapter 4796. of the Revised Code to an applicant if either of the following applies: (1) The applicant holds a license in another state. (2) The applicant has satisfactory work experience, a government certification, or a private certification as described in that chapter as a podiatrist in a state that does not issue that license.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of podiatric medicine and surgery without a current, valid license to practice podiatric medicine and surgery issued by the state medical board.

title_protection.quote: No person shall advertise or claim to be authorized to practice podiatric medicine and surgery unless the person holds a current, valid license to practice podiatric medicine and surgery issued by the board under this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of podiatric medicine and surgery without a current, valid license to practice podiatric medicine and surgery issued by the state medical board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, renewing, or securing any license or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: committed fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, renewing, or securing any license or certificate to practice or certificate to recommend issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting one's name or license to be used by a person not actually directing treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting one's name or one's license or certificate to practice to be used by a person, group, or corporation when the individual concerned is not actually directing the treatment given

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain minimal standards in selection or administration of drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain minimal standards applicable to the selection or administration of drugs, or failure to employ acceptable scientific methods in the selection of drugs or other modalities for treatment of disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, giving away, prescribing, or administering drugs for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: selling, giving away, personally furnishing, prescribing, or administering drugs for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully betraying a professional confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully betraying a professional confidence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading statement in solicitation of patients or advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading statement in the solicitation of or advertising for patients; in relation to the practice of medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, podiatric medicine and surgery, or a limited branch of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Departure from or failure to conform to minimal standards of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A departure from, or the failure to conform to, minimal standards of care of similar practitioners under the same or similar circumstances, whether or not actual injury to a patient is established

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining money or anything of value by fraudulent misrepresentations in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The obtaining of, or attempting to obtain, money or anything of value by fraudulent misrepresentations in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Plea of guilty to or judicial finding of guilt of a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Plea of guilty to or judicial finding of guilt of a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Plea of guilty to or judicial finding of guilt of a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the conditions of limitation placed by the board upon a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the conditions of limitation placed by the board upon a license or certificate to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay license renewal fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to pay license renewal fees specified in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in division of fees for referral of patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in the division of fees for referral of patients, or the receiving of a thing of value in return for a specific referral of a patient to utilize a particular service or business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of a code of ethics of a national professional organization including the American Podiatric Medical Association
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of any provision of a code of ethics of the American medical association, the American osteopathic association, the American podiatric medical association, or any other national professional organizations that the board specifies by rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice according to acceptable standards due to mental or physical illness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care by reason of mental illness or physical illness, including, but not limited to, physical deterioration that adversely affects cognitive, motor, or perceptive skills.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision of this chapter or any rule promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate, any provisions of this chapter or any rule promulgated by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Limitation, revocation, or suspension of license by another licensing agency for any reason other than nonpayment of fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the limitation, revocation, or suspension of an individual's license to practice; acceptance of an individual's license surrender; denial of a license; refusal to renew or reinstate a license; imposition of probation; or issuance of an order of censure or other reprimand

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impairment of ability to practice due to substance use disorder or excessive use of drugs or alcohol
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impairment of ability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care because of substance use disorder or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances that may impair ability to practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to use universal blood and body fluid precautions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to use universal blood and body fluid precautions established by rules adopted under section 4731.051 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide notice to patient of lack of malpractice insurance coverage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide notice to, and receive acknowledgment of the notice from, a patient when required by section 4731.143 of the Revised Code prior to providing nonemergency professional services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a podiatrist to enter into a standard care arrangement with a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a physician or podiatrist to enter into a standard care arrangement with a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner with whom the physician or podiatrist is in collaboration pursuant to section 4731.27 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate in an investigation conducted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate in an investigation conducted by the board under division (F) of this section, including failure to comply with a subpoena or order issued by the board or failure to answer truthfully a question presented by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Waiving deductibles or copayments as an enticement to patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Waiving the payment of all or any part of a deductible or copayment that a patient, pursuant to a health insurance or health care policy, contract, or plan that covers the individual's services, otherwise would be required to pay if the waiver is used as an enticement to a patient or group of patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with requirements for reviewing the drug database before prescribing opioid analgesics or benzodiazepines
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of section 4729.79 or 4731.055 of the Revised Code, unless the state board of pharmacy no longer maintains a drug database

definition_quote.value: The practice of podiatric medicine and surgery consists of the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot; and superficial lesions of the hand other than those associated with trauma.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of podiatric medicine and surgery consists of the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot; and superficial lesions of the hand other than those associated with trauma.

methods_authorized.quote: the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists are permitted the use of such preparations, medicines, and drugs as may be necessary for the treatment of such ailments.
drug_authority.quote: Podiatrists are permitted the use of such preparations, medicines, and drugs as may be necessary for the treatment of such ailments.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: General anaesthetics may be used under this section only in colleges of podiatric medicine and surgery in good standing with the state medical board and in hospitals approved by the joint commission or the American osteopathic association.

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: the patient shall be concurrently referred to a doctor of medicine or a doctor of osteopathic medicine and surgery for the treatment of the systemic disease itself

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: A podiatrist may treat the local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear in the hand and foot

value: American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery
board_certification_body.quote: The podiatrist is board-certified or board-qualified by the American board of foot and ankle surgery or the American board of podiatric medicine.

professional_liability_insurance_require.quote: Each person holding a valid license issued under this chapter authorizing the license holder to practice medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or podiatric medicine and surgery, who is not covered by medical malpractice insurance shall provide a patient with written notice of the license holder's lack of that insurance coverage

telehealth_authorized.quote: A physician may provide telehealth services in accordance with sections 4743.09 of the Revised Code.

opioid_prescribing_rules_required.quote: a physician shall comply with all of the following as conditions of prescribing a drug that is either an opioid analgesic or a benzodiazepine

vaccination_authority.quote: A podiatrist may administer to individuals who are seven years of age or older vaccinations against both of the following: (A) Influenza; (B) COVID-19.

advanced_practice_nurse_collaboration_au.quote: A physician or podiatrist shall enter into a standard care arrangement with each clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner with whom the physician or podiatrist is in collaboration.

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: The state medical board shall establish a confidential, nondisciplinary program for the evaluation and treatment of practitioners and applicants who are, or may be, impaired
